subject: science
topicName: Acids, Bases, and Salts: Identifying Them with Indicators
description: Classify common acids, bases, and salts using pH, litmus, and natural indicators such as red cabbage juice, while applying safe household investigation practices.
learningObjectives: Identify common acids, bases, and salts from everyday examples
Describe how litmus and red cabbage indicators change color in acids and bases
Use indicator evidence and pH ranges to classify a substance as acidic, basic, or neutral
Explain that salts can form when acids and bases react in neutralization
prerequisites: Difference between physical and chemical changes
Safe handling of household materials without tasting or mixing unknown substances
